caption: Kim v. Hanlon
citation_line: Kim v. Hanlon, No. 3:24-cv-01098; aff’d, No. 24-1594 (3d Cir. Apr. 17, 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Quraishi preliminarily barred use of New Jersey’s “county line” ballot design for the 2024 Democratic primary and required an office-block format with randomized order.
qualification_rationale: The decision disrupted a ballot structure unique to New Jersey, drew national and statewide political coverage, and addressed severe burdens on candidates’ and voters’ First and Fourteenth Amendment rights.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in a precedential opinion, calling the district opinion thorough and carefully reasoned and finding no abuse of discretion. The preliminary injunction did not itself finally adjudicate the entire underlying case.
